text:
Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Quantres Asset Management LTD Has Upped Its Holding in Coty (COTY) as Shares Declined; Zweig-Dimenna Associates Lifted Air Lease (AL) Position 
March 4, 2018 - By Ellis Scott 
Joe Dimenna increased its stake in Air Lease Corp (AL) by 90.4% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Zweig-Dimenna Associates Llc bought 74,500 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.16% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund run by Joe Dimenna held 156,913 shares of the diversified commercial services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $6.69M, up from 82,413 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Zweig-Dimenna Associates Llc who had been investing in Air Lease Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $4.46B market cap company. It closed at $43.01 lastly. It is down 29.12% since March 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 12.42% the S&P500. 
Quantres Asset Management Ltd increased its stake in Coty Inc (COTY) by 406.36% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Quantres Asset Management Ltd bought 44,700 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.74% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 55,700 shares of the package goods and cosmetics company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $921,000, up from 11,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Quantres Asset Management Ltd who had been investing in Coty Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $14.59B market cap company. The stock increased 2.15% or $0.41 during the last trading session, reaching $19.45. About 4.95 million shares traded. Coty Inc. (NYSE:COTY) has declined 25.39% since March 4, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.09% the S&P500. 
Since February 12, 2018, it had 1 insider buy, and 0 selling transactions for $84.48 million activity.

It also reduced its holding in General Electric Co (NYSE:GE) by 26,400 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 16,200 shares, and cut its stake in Macy’s Inc (NYSE:M).
